ic_name: ARM Serial Wire Debug (SWD) — ADIv5 (ARM IHI 0031C)
fsm_summary: SWD wire-level state machine sequences each 46-bit transaction through 6 phases (Request → Turnaround → ACK → Data → Parity → Turnaround). SWDIO direction flips at the Turnaround periods. The SWJ-DP variant adds a mode-select state machine that watches for the 16-bit JTAG-to-SWD (0xE79E) and SWD-to-JTAG (0xE73C) selection sequences.

fsm_hints.clock: SWCLK is host-driven and free-running during a transaction.
fsm_hints.sampling_edge: Target samples SWDIO on SWCLK rising edge during Request and Data-Write phases.
fsm_hints.drive_edge: Target drives SWDIO on SWCLK falling edge during ACK and Data-Read phases.
fsm_hints.abort: 50 consecutive SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=HIGH = line reset.
fsm_hints.transaction_overlap: Posted reads: data of read N delivered with ACK of read N+1.
fsm_hints.instruction_change_path: Switching from DP to AP transactions requires writing DP.SELECT first.

anti_deadlock_rule: 50-cycle line reset is the universal escape — there is no SWD state from which this sequence does not return to Idle. Guarantees host can always recover SWD without power-cycling.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up, SW-DP starts quiescent; host's first action is a 50-cycle line reset followed by an IDCODE/DPIDR read. On line reset, SELECT and CTRL/STAT are cleared, AP selection resets to APSEL=0/APBANKSEL=0, and the posted-read queue is drained. DPIDR is hard-wired and always available.

default_ready_state_recommendation.SWCLK: Idle level not specified; debug probe drives. Most probes leave SWCLK low between transactions.

configurations.name: Single-target SWD
configurations.description: One SoC on the SWD bus; host directly drives SWCLK/SWDIO.

configurations.name: Multi-drop SWD
configurations.description: Multiple SoCs share SWDIO/SWCLK; per-target selection via DP TARGETSEL (ADIv5.2).

configurations.name: SWJ-DP mode-switched
configurations.description: SoC supports both SWD and JTAG; mode is selected at runtime via 16-bit selection sequences.

timing_dependency_rule: All transaction-state-machine transitions are synchronous to SWCLK. Target drives SWDIO on the falling edge during target-driven phases; host samples on the rising edge.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: Idle
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Between transactions. SWDIO is host-driven HIGH.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: RequestRx
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Target shifts in the 8-bit Request packet.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: DataDrive_Read
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Read + ACK=OK: target drives 32 data bits.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: DataDrive_Write
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Write + ACK=OK: host drives 32 data bits.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: ParityDrive_Write
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Write: host drives parity; target checks → WDATAERR on mismatch.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: WaitOrFault
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: ACK=WAIT or FAULT: host ignores data.

fsm_states_swd_transaction.name: LineResetDetect
fsm_states_swd_transaction.description: Detects 50+ SWCLKs with SWDIO=HIGH; forces SW-DP Idle.

fsm_states_swj_dp_mode_select.name: WatchSWDSelect
fsm_states_swj_dp_mode_select.description: After ≥ 50 cycles TMS=1, watches for 0xE79E pattern.

fsm_states_swj_dp_mode_select.name: WatchJTAGSelect
fsm_states_swj_dp_mode_select.description: After ≥ 50 cycles SWDIO=1, watches for 0xE73C pattern.

swd_to_jtag_mode_switching.selection_sequence_preconditions: Both selection sequences must be preceded by ≥ 50 cycles of SWDIO/TMS=HIGH and followed by ≥ 50 cycles of SWDIO/TMS=HIGH.
